# Hemmi

> AI-powered writing assistant for research papers, essays, and academic documents.

Hemmi helps students and researchers write faster with AI assistance, proper citations, and academic rigor. Write research papers, essays, reports, and dissertations 10x faster without sacrificing quality.

## Features

- AI-assisted research and source discovery
- Automated citation generation (APA, MLA, Chicago, IEEE)
- Structured document generation with outlines
- Literature review assistance
- Academic tone and style guidance
- Real-time editing and proofreading suggestions
